variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one finished, professional logo for a womenswear boutique for women aged 24–38. Exact text ONLY: "DONA", all four uppercase Latin letters correctly spelled, on one line. Crucial: the second letter is a complete clearly readable letter O, with a realistic lipstick kiss imprint INSIDE its negative-space counter. The imprint must fit completely inside the O with visible breathing room on all sides and must not cross or obscure the letter strokes. Natural pressed lipstick transfer, two anatomically credible lip impressions, defined cupid bow, delicate vertical lip creases, organic tiny gaps of pigment, softly uneven pressure, narrow natural separation between lips. It is a lipstick stain, not a drawing of lips, not glossy 3D lips, not clipart, no face, no teeth, no tongue. Elegant feminine fashion identity, tasteful and restrained. Single deep ruby ink #66021F with pigment-density variation only inside the imprint. Transparent background, no white plate, no shadows, no mockup, no labels, no extra icons or text. Large centered horizontal wordmark, crisp typography, generous clear margins. High-resolution clean edges and refined kerning. Variant 1: couture editorial high-contrast upright Didone serif with exquisite fine serifs, tall oval O, substantial vertical strokes. Kiss centered horizontally and upright in the O. Quiet luxury and clarity.
variants.revision: Edit this provided DONA logo. Preserve the exact typography, letter positions, ruby color, transparent background and the entire wordmark. Change ONLY the kiss inside O. Make the lipstick imprint 15% smaller to ensure a clear gap all around. Most important: replace the flat solid lips with a genuinely realistic dry lipstick transfer print. The lips must have abundant VISIBLE transparent irregular creases, finely branching vertical fissures, broken pigment islands, lighter semitransparent rubbed areas and porous uneven contact, like an actual kiss stamped on glass then isolated. At least 25–35% of the lip surface must be visibly clear or translucent in natural crease patterns. Strong readable texture at normal logo viewing size. Refined narrow lip opening, natural cupid bow, soft irregular edges; not a solid lip icon and not a glossy mouth. No white-painted lines: all missing pigment is truly transparent. Keep the print entirely inside the O without touching it. Do not add anything else.
